This is a test synopsis.
''' # Prepare a playlist JSON with one media file and one subtitle playlist_json = { "Playlist": { "Video": { "Base": "https://cdn.example.com/", "MediaFiles": [ {"Href": "/video1.mp4"}, {"Href": "/video2.m3u8"} ], "Subtitles": [ {"Href": "https://cdn.example.com/subs.vtt"} ], "Duration": "PT1H30M" } } } extractor = DummyITVIE(webpage, playlist_json) result = extractor._real_extract("https://www.itv.com/hub/test/vid123") # Basic info checks assert result["id"] == "vid123" assert result["title"] == "Test Episode" assert result["description"] == "This is a test synopsis." assert result["duration"] == 5400 # 1h30m in seconds # Formats formats = result["formats"] assert any(f.get("url") == "https://cdn.example.com/video1.mp4" for f in formats) # m3u8 format should be extracted via _extract_m3u8_formats assert any(f.get("format_id") == "hls" for f in formats) # Subtitles subtitles = result["subtitles"] assert "en" in subtitles assert subtitles["en"][0]["url"] == "https://cdn.example.com/subs.vtt" assert subtitles["en"][0]["ext"] == "vtt" def test_itvie_no_media_files(tmp_path): # Webpage with required attributes but playlist has no MediaFiles webpage = '''
''' playlist_json = { "Playlist": { "Video": { "Base": None, "MediaFiles": [], "Subtitles": [], "Duration": "PT0M" } } } extractor = DummyITVIE(webpage, playlist_json) result = extractor._real_extract("https://www.itv.com/hub/test/vid456") # Formats list should be empty assert result["formats"] == [] # Subtitles should be empty assert result["subtitles"] == {} # Duration zero assert result["duration"] == 0 def test_itvie_missing_playlist_attribute(): # Webpage missing both data-video-playlist and data-video-id webpage = '''
''' playlist_json = {} extractor = DummyITVIE(webpage, playlist_json) with pytest.raises(KeyError): extractor._real_extract("https://www.itv.com/hub/test/vid789") ```
